instructions_to_main_agent: The Magazine section of the homepage has been completely redesigned. The legacy '.mfd-home-magazine--rows' class has been removed and an asymmetrical grid editorial layout (2fr 1fr) has been implemented. The cards now feature large, impactful images with dark gradient overlays, and the titles (in Cormorant Garamond) are overlaid directly on the images to evoke a premium editorial feel, akin to Vogue Living or AD Italia.

Magazine.description: Editorial grid redesign 2026. Layout: hero (2fr, grid-row 1/3) + 2 sub (1fr, aspect-ratio 4/3) with 3px gap. All cards use position:relative + media position:absolute inset:0 (fills card). Gradient veil: rgba(6,4,2,0.88) bottom to transparent 72%. Body position:absolute bottom:0 with Cormorant title (hero: clamp(26px,2.6vw,40px)). hover: img scale(1.06) + read-cta reveal translateY(0). Accent ::after underline scaleX(1) on hover. Responsive: tablet=hero full-width 16/7 + 2 sub 4/3 side-by-side; mobile=single column stack 4/3.

css_guidelines.description: Grid uses 2fr/1fr asymmetric layout. Media absolute inset:0. Gradient veil to top. Body absolute bottom:0. Hover: scale+read-cta reveal+accent underline.
